```{r}
# Load dependencies. 
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(ggnested)
library(ggtext)

df <- read.csv("results.csv") # Import raw data
```

```{r}
# Lookup tables for chip no to condition and ROI to fractal maze complexity assignment
fractal_map <- c(
  setNames(rep(0, 7), c(4, 6, 9, 12, 13, 16, 19)),
  setNames(rep(1, 7), c(2, 10, 15, 20, 22, 24, 25)),
  setNames(rep(3, 7), c(7, 8, 17, 18, 21, 23, 27)),
  setNames(rep(5, 7), c(1, 3, 5, 11, 14, 26, 28))
)

condition_map <- c(
  "P" = "P",
  "B" = "B",
  "BP" = "BP",
  "PB" = "BP",
  "1" = "B",
  "2" = "BN",
  "3" = "BPN",
  "4" = "BP",
  "5" = "PN",
  "6" = "P",
  "7" = "B",
  "8" = "BN",
  "9" = "BPN",
  "10" = "BP",
  "11" = "PN",
  "12" = "P",
  "13" = "B",
  "14" = "BN",
  "15" = "BPN",
  "16" = "BP",
  "17" = "PN",
  "18" = "P",
  "19" = "B",
  "20" = "BN",
  "21" = "BPN",
  "22" = "BP",
  "23" = "PN"
)

df_arranged <- df %>%
  mutate(
    fractal   = unname(fractal_map[as.character(ROI_index)]),
    condition = unname(condition_map[as.character(Chip)]),
    time      = 2 * Timepoint
  ) %>%
  rename(ch = Channel) %>%
  mutate(ch = case_when(ch == 0 ~ "G",
                        ch == 1 ~ "R",
                        TRUE    ~ NA_character_))


df_sum_fractal <- df_arranged %>% group_by(time, condition, fractal, ch) %>% summarise(
    n      = sum(!is.na(IntDen)),
    mean   = mean(IntDen, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd     = sd(IntDen, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem    = sd / sqrt(n),
    median = median(IntDen, na.rm = TRUE),
    min    = min(IntDen, na.rm = TRUE),
    max    = max(IntDen, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
)

df_sum <- df_arranged %>% group_by(time, condition, ch) %>% summarise(
    n      = sum(!is.na(IntDen)),
    mean   = mean(IntDen, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd     = sd(IntDen, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem    = sd / sqrt(n),
    median = median(IntDen, na.rm = TRUE),
    min    = min(IntDen, na.rm = TRUE),
    max    = max(IntDen, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
)

df_combined <- bind_rows(
  df_sum_fractal %>% mutate(fractal = as.character(fractal)),
  df_sum %>% mutate(fractal = "Mean")
)
```

## Visualize

### GFP across all fractals:

```{r}
#| output: true
#| label: GFP
#| fig-cap: GFP intensity of all conditions averaged across all levels of fractal complexity.

GFP <- df_sum %>% 
  filter(ch == "G") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = mean, color = condition)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_errorbar( aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem), width = 0.5 ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y="GFP", x="time [d]")

GFP

```

### RFP across all fractals:

```{r}
#| output: true
#| label: RFP
#| fig-cap: RFP intensity of all conditions averaged across all levels of fractal complexity.

RFP <- df_sum %>% 
  filter(ch == "R") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = mean, color = condition)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_errorbar( aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem), width = 0.5 ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y="RFP", x="time [d]")

RFP
```

### GFP for *P. putida* per fractal:

```{r}
#| output: true
#| label: GFP_f
#| fig-cap: GFP intensity of all conditions per level of fractal complexity.
GFP_f <- df_sum_fractal %>% 
  filter(ch == "G") %>% filter(condition %in% c("P", "BP", "BPN")) %>% 
  ggnested(aes(x = time, y = mean, main_group = condition, sub_group = fractal)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_errorbar( aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem), width = 0.5 ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y="GFP", x="time [d]")

GFP_f
```

### Interactive Plot
```{r}
d <- df_sum_fractal %>%
  filter(ch == "G", condition %in% c("P", "BP", "BPN")) %>%
  mutate(group = paste(condition, fractal, sep = "_"))

plot_ly(
  d,
  x = ~time, y = ~mean,
  color = ~group,
  type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
  error_y = ~list(array = sem, thickness = 1, width = 4)
) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "time [d]"),
    yaxis = list(title = "GFP"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "condition_fractal"))
  )
```

```{r}
#| output: true
#| label: interact
#| fig-cap: Interactive plot of fluorescence intensity of all conditions per levels of fractal complexity.

library(crosstalk)

# 1. Data: one row per point, plus a combined group for coloring
d <- df_combined %>%
  filter(ch == "G", condition %in% c("P", "BP", "BPN")) %>%
  mutate(
    fractal = factor(fractal),
    group   = paste(condition, fractal, sep = "_")
  )

# 2. Nested palette: one hue per condition, shades per fractal
#    (mimics what ggnested does)
base <- c(P = "#1b9e77", BP = "#d95f02", BPN = "#7570b3")
n_fr <- nlevels(d$fractal)

pal <- unlist(lapply(names(base), function(cn) {
  cols <- colorRampPalette(c(base[[cn]], "white"))(n_fr + 2)[1:n_fr]
  setNames(cols, paste(cn, levels(d$fractal), sep = "_"))
}))

# 3. Shared data for the checkboxes
sd <- SharedData$new(d)

# 4. Plot (plot_ly is more reliable with crosstalk than ggplotly)
p <- plot_ly(
  sd,
  x = ~time, y = ~mean,
  color = ~group, colors = pal,
  type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
  error_y = ~list(array = sem, thickness = 1, width = 4),
  text = ~paste0("condition: ", condition, "<br>fractal: ", fractal),
  hoverinfo = "text+x+y"
) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "time [d]"),
    yaxis = list(title = "GFP"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "condition_fractal"))
  )

# 5. Checkboxes next to the plot
bscols(
  widths = c(2, 10),
  list(
    filter_checkbox("cond", "Condition", sd, ~condition, inline = FALSE),
    filter_checkbox("frac", "Fractal",   sd, ~fractal,   inline = FALSE)
  ),
  p
)
```
